Synagogue Church on Margaret Street, Brsibane, 1949
An allotment in Margaret Street was earmarked as the proposed site of the Brisbane Synagogue in 1885, with the foundation stone laid by Rev. A. P. Phillips on July 7th of that year. One year later, on the 18th of July 1886, the Brisbane Synagogue building was completed and consecrated with great ceremonies and celebrations. The building was designed by Arthur Morry, built by A. Midson, costing 5500 pounds. (Description supplied with photograph.).
